summary: Document and exercise attributed scratch clients under mission exec ancestry without weakening caller guards.

replay.detail: Documentation and regression tests only; no runtime or replay changes.

schema.detail: No stored format or database changes.

rules.detail: Existing agent and run authorization rules remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Uses the existing explicit ST_AGENT caller contract; no new wire or CLI fields.

downtime.detail: No deployment or daemon restart is required.

manual.detail: Private integration harnesses under mission exec ancestry must exec scratch clients with an explicit fixture ST_AGENT, omit run and legacy agent markers, and use the matching agent actor and isolated endpoint; see docs/st3/program-engine.md, Private integration instances.

recovery.detail: No runtime changes or migrations to undo; fixture harness changes may be reverted independently.
